blocks.title: Revenue aur profit
blocks.text: Revenue woh tamam raqam hai jo karobar maal ya khidmat bech kar kamata hai. Profit tamam kharche, jaise kiraya, tankhwahein aur maal ki laagat, nikalne ke baad bachne wali raqam hai.

Lahore ki dukaan 100 school bags Rs 500 fi bag bechti hai: revenue = 100 x 500 = Rs 50,000. Kul kharche Rs 30,000 hon to profit = 50,000 - 30,000 = Rs 20,000. Kitab batati hai ke kai chhote Pakistani karobar ghair rasmi shobe mein hain aur revenue aur profit hamesha nahi batate, jis se maeeshat naapna mushkil hota hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: qualitative aur quantitative market research, rujhan, hisson, muqabileen aur pesh-goi ki misalon ke saath. Oopar daen: revenue Rs 50,000, costs Rs 30,000 aur profit Rs 20,000 ki bars. Neeche baen: bakery budget ki patti, kiraya, ajza, tankhwahein aur utilities, kul Rs 750,000, qarz aur bachat ke hisab ke saath. Neeche daen: design, share, feedback aur refine ka chakkar.
blocks.caption: Market insight, paisa aur iteration (topics 9.3 se 9.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Qualitative research interviews aur focus groups se raye samajhti hai; quantitative research surveys se naapti hai ke log kitni baar aur kitna khareedte hain; data ka tajziya rujhan, hisse, muqabil aur aainda talab zahir karta hai. 100 bags Rs 500 mein bechne wali dukaan Rs 50,000 revenue kamati, aur Rs 30,000 kharche ke baad Rs 20,000 munafa. Bakery ka Rs 750,000 ka mahana budget kiraye, ajza, tankhwahon aur utilities mein bata hai. 10% salana par Rs 100,000 ka qarz Rs 110,000 mein wapas hota hai. Kaam design, share, feedback aur behtari ke chakkar dar chakkar se behtar hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar dukaan 120 bags Rs 500 mein beche aur kharche Rs 35,000 ho jayein to revenue aur profit kya hain?

items: Revenue = tadaad x qeemat; profit = revenue - kharche (Rs 50,000 - 30,000 = Rs 20,000).
